note: Four hours is the middle of the range DeCA prices and what the market builds. Fixing the duration matters for a second reason: EPM applies one CAPEX multiplier to both the power and the energy part of a battery, and those two decline at different rates in DeCA. At a fixed duration the multiplier is exact on the total, which is what is being bought. Round trip efficiency of 0.9 is the EPM reference value, data_test; DeCA gives none. First year 2028 because the model opens in 2026 and a battery programme is not instantaneous. Twenty years of life is the industry convention for a lithium battery at one cycle a day; DeCA gives a Life Time for its solar and wind candidates but none for storage.
